changes.text: Step back and look at the design. It trades an unanswerable question — does he mean to stay? — for a visible act: does he accept the marriage? The servant's reading of Wu Qi is on the record — in translation, that he was a man of integrity and restraint who cherished his good name. That is the history's description of him, not a sketch invented here. One explanation for the scheme's success: Wu Qi, seeing the princess treat the chancellor so cheaply, declined the match. Agreeing to a marriage while the household he was visiting was being humiliated would not fit the name-cherishing character the servant attributed to him. He acted just as the servant had predicted, and stepped into a frame drawn around that reading of his character. (The author's interpretation.)
回头看这套设计，它把一个说不清的问题（他心里留不留），换成了一个看得见的动作（接不接婚事）。仆人对吴起的判断是：「吳起為人節廉而自喜名也。」这是史书的记述，不是本文替他写的人格。一种解释是，计策能成，靠的是吴起见公主贱魏相就不肯接受这门亲事：看见主家受辱还答应婚事，与仆人所描述的那种自惜名声的性情不合。他的举动正如仆人所料，落进了别人按这一判断画好的框里。（作者解释）

dispositions.rationale: 在英文段末补上“(The author's interpretation.)”。这样英文的解释标注覆盖到末句“stepped into a frame drawn around that reading of his character”，与中文段末“（作者解释）”的范围一致。中文字段内容未改，按中英同步规则一并给出完整文字。

evidence.quote: 於是吳起見公主之賤魏相，果辭魏武侯
